d:
Bina grate kiye, bas aaloo ke chhote cubes se bane Crispy Cheese Hash Brown Bahar kurkure, andar soft.
Ek baar banao aur freezer mein store karo, jab mann ho tab fry karo.
Market jaisa Crispy Cheese Hash Brown ghar par
Aaloo ko 60-70% ubalne aur aadha dabane ki trick
Breadcrumb ya suji ke bina crispy coating ka tarika
Freezer mein 1 mahine tak store karne ka tarika
Comment karein, Aap hash brown ketchup ke saath khaayenge ya chutney ke saath?
